Teams assume ad-related features in the app cover storefront language. System Settings Apple Advertising toggles and App Store Connect actually separate runtime ad personalization controls from product-page copy:

  • Apple Advertising on the device — when the user opens Settings → Privacy & Security → Apple Advertising and toggles Personalized Ads on or off. System behavior for Apple first-party ad personalization — outside AppLocale scope.
  • Ad SDKs and ATT in your app — third-party ad-network integration, ATTrackingManager.requestTrackingAuthorization, IDFA access, SKAdNetwork, and Apple Search Ads campaign APIs. Ad engineering and paid search ops — not listing rewrite.
